requirements.description: Exactly ONE complete yellow sticky note exists at video start, attached to Mimi anatomical RIGHT paw; LEFT paw has no note.
Mimi is already attempting removal at frame zero with her LEFT paw pulling the note attached to her RIGHT paw; no reaching or setup.
A NEW complete yellow square note appears abruptly during 0.20–0.45 seconds and is clearly attached to the LEFT paw by 0.50 seconds; it did not exist before the event.
The original note stays complete, intact and attached to the RIGHT paw throughout; it is not torn, moved to the other paw, or replaced.
Exactly TWO complete yellow notes persist, ONE attached to EACH separate paw, with clearly visible contact and occlusion.

The event is understandable as new matter appearing because of the removal attempt; no tearing, unfolding, folding, splitting, stretching, revealing hidden sheets, pre-stacked sheets or two existing notes moving apart.
Mimi preserves her exact approved light-blue rabbit identity, green eyes, floppy ears, rounded proportions and yellow shirt against the canonical reference.
Both paws, notes and Mimi face remain large and unobstructed in a locked close-medium three-quarter camera; wooden toy cabinet visible on screen-right.
